research_question: Can a learned model distinguish three independently manipulated adult embodied-motivation signal axes under counterfactual and word-order controls, and does performance survive a label-permutation falsifier?

outcomes: Synthetic adult non-graphic dataset: 32 rows, 16 train / 8 validation / 8 held-out test, zero OOV and exact disjointness
Primary real checkpoint: 3,982 parameters, trained from scratch, clean validation 17/17 checks PASS
Primary exact-match: train 1.0, validation 0.5, held-out test 0.25
Label-permutation control held-out exact-match: 0.125; primary is higher but remains low and bounded
Primary held-out axis accuracy: 1.0 body-signal proxy / 0.75 desire-report / 0.375 liking-report
Focused evidence tests: 4 passed; no private/intimate data, minors, graphic content or paid resource

hold_items: Proxy labels do not establish actual arousal, desire, liking, pleasure, consent or phenomenal experience
The model may exploit lexical/template regularities; stronger prompt and keyword controls remain needed
The held-out test is small and the liking axis is weak
Local-only checkpoint binary remains outside Git
Adult sexuality authorization does not authorize runtime, productization, deployment or canonical promotion
